description: Canonical Forma motion taxonomy (MOT-010) and the shared variable vocabulary each model may use (MOT-012). The motion audit (tools/motion-audit.mjs) reads this file; it is the single machine-readable source for model selection.

inertial.label: Inertial / spring response
inertial.phenomenon: An object with perceived mass settling toward a stable state after activation or release.
inertial.reducedMotion: Remove travel, overshoot, bounce and spatial compression; place the final state immediately or nearly immediately.

gravity.label: Gravity-derived directional response
gravity.phenomenon: A small directional cue evoking vertical travel under uniform acceleration. Timing is independent of mass.

cadence.label: Constant-velocity / cadence motion
cadence.phenomenon: Continuous or repeated activity, or a bounded discrete sequence, whose primary parameter is a named period, velocity or cadence.
cadence.reducedMotion: Stop repeated motion; retain a static activity or status indication.

direct.label: Direct-manipulation / authoritative-value tracking
direct.phenomenon: The pointer, scroll position, native control value or application value is authoritative; the visual is a projection of it.
direct.reducedMotion: Preserve the direct mapping; add no smoothing or lag.

perceptual.label: Perceptual interpolation
perceptual.phenomenon: Opacity, color, backdrop tint, blur and other non-spatial presentation changes. Never assigned fake mass, gravity or spring semantics.
perceptual.reducedMotion: May retain a brief non-spatial transition when it materially improves comprehension.

parameters.--forma-motion-mass: inertial mass m (preset input; never domain semantics)
parameters.--forma-motion-base-duration: dimensional scale that maps the normalized model to UI time

--forma-motion-state-duration.reason: Derived from inertial duration (0.72 x T_inertia), so it assigns mass to non-spatial change, which MOT-010 (5) forbids. Retained as a compatibility variable for consumers; shipped Forma selectors migrate to the perceptual tokens.

bundles._description: Groups whose definitions a track in each group may rely on at runtime. Marketing ships as a standalone bundle, so it must define every canonical variable it uses.
